paragraphs: As in [Pesachim 117b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.117b.20), where he asked Rava. In [Chullin 80a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.80a.17) he said to Rav Ashi: “Ameimar permits their fat.”[^1]

notes.text: In Pesachim he questions Rava about the cup after the meal. In Chullin he tells Rav Ashi that Ameimar permits the animals’ fat.
